description: Boeing’s CST-100 Starliner spacecraft completed a critical safety milestone on Monday, Nov 4 in an end-to-end test of its abort system. The Pad Abort Test took place at Launch Complex 32 at the U.S. Army’s White Sands Missile Range in New Mexico.
keywords: Boeing CST-100 Starliner, Commercial Crew Program, Pad Abort Test, White Sands Missile Range
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
